title: Mase's Chill Stuff
description: A  bunch of quality of life features, This pack includes: More mobs, Shaders, Furniture, Better animations, and wayyyy more amazing stuff to make sure your Minecraft world is the most amazing it can be!
body:
This ModPack Add's a bunch of quality of life features + Tons of new mobs + Really cool shaders!
This has many cool things like more third player anims, better item anims, and wayyyy better mob anims!

THIS MODPACK WILL RECEIVE MANY UPDATES TO IMPROVE QOL!

Make sure you have a good computer/PC. works fine on a gaming laptop so it should run fine on most setups.

We will update this modpack as often as we can!
